empty: No identity provider yet; local accounts keep signing in as usual.

entra.s1: Register Yagra as an application in Entra ID.
entra.s2: Add the redirect URI below as a Web redirect URI.
entra.s3: Enter the Directory (tenant) ID from the app's Overview below, or a verified domain.
entra.s4: To map roles from groups, turn on the groups claim under Token configuration.

okta.s1: Register Yagra as an OIDC Web application in Okta.
okta.s2: Add the redirect URI below as a sign-in redirect URI.
okta.s3: For a custom authorization server, choose Other instead.

google.s1: In Google Cloud, create an OAuth client of type Web application.
google.s2: Add the redirect URI below as an authorized redirect URI.

generic.s1: Register Yagra as an OIDC client at your provider.
generic.s2: Add the redirect URI below as an allowed redirect URI.

delete.title: Delete provider
delete.confirm: Delete the SSO provider "{{name}}"? Users who sign in via SSO will no longer be able to.

field.name: Display name
field.issuerUnrecognized: Shown as stored; pick the provider again to use its own field.
field.issuerParamInvalid: Enter the name alone, without https:// or a path.

roleMap.label: Group → role mapping
roleMap.info: When a user's groups match several rows, the highest role wins.

field.defaultRoleNone: None — deny if no group maps
field.defaultRoleRequired: Required: this provider sends no groups, so everyone who signs in gets this role.

ldap.title: Directory (LDAP/AD)

test.role: This account would sign in as {{role}}.
test.denied: This account would be DENIED — no group maps to a role and there is no default role.

err.port: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
err.bindDn: The service account's DN is required.
err.bindPassword: A service account password is required. It cannot be blank — an empty password would make the search anonymous.
err.userBaseDn: A user base DN is required.
err.userFilter: The user filter must contain {username}, or it matches every entry under the base DN.
err.groupPair: A group search needs both a group base DN and a group filter, or neither.
err.groupFilter: The group filter must contain {user_dn} (or {username}) so it matches one person.
err.noMapping: Enabling the directory needs at least one group mapping or a default role — otherwise every login is denied.
err.save: Could not save the directory settings.

roleMap.info: A group matches by its full DN or by its name alone, ignoring case. When several match, the highest role wins.

groupSearch.info: With both group fields empty, membership is read from the user entry alone. Nested groups on Active Directory need a search: (member:1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941:={user_dn})

ldap.revokeWarning: Saving this signs out every directory account and stops directory sign-in.

redirectUriMismatch: ⚠️ A saved SSO redirect URI does not match this address, so sign-in fails at the callback.

redirectFix.title: How to fix it
redirectFix.s1: Edit the provider below and set its redirect URI to <c>{{uri}}</c>.
redirectFix.s2: Register the same URL as an allowed redirect at the identity provider.

publicDashboard.title: Public dashboard
publicDashboard.stateOn_one: On — anonymous visitors can see the public board and the {{count}} API route it reads.
publicDashboard.stateOn_other: On — anonymous visitors can see the public board and the {{count}} API routes it reads.
publicDashboard.stateOff: Off — every page requires signing in.
publicDashboard.confirmOnTitle: Serve the public board without a login?
publicDashboard.confirmOnBody_one: Anyone who can reach this deployment will see the public board, and the {{count}} API route its widgets read. Nothing else becomes reachable, and nothing can be changed anonymously.
publicDashboard.confirmOnBody_other: Anyone who can reach this deployment will see the public board, and the {{count}} API routes its widgets read. Nothing else becomes reachable, and nothing can be changed anonymously.
publicDashboard.confirmOnEmpty: The public board is empty; add widgets in <lnk/> first.
publicDashboard.confirmOffBody: Anonymous visitors stop seeing the public board immediately on this core, and within 30 seconds on any standby. The board itself is kept.
publicDashboard.loadFailed: Could not read the public dashboard setting
publicDashboard.saveFailed: Could not change the public dashboard setting
